test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer - General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'BREATHE' is coded as 70 and 'TRIUMPH' is coded as 135. How will 'TRAGEDY' be coded in the same language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed079e56f511f2b5119275a9e92435a276e76a0481cf64928e701f0f5d0e1235.png] The pattern followed here is: Sum of consonant place value and sum of Vowels place value multiply by 2. 'BREATHE' is coded as 70
